knowledge:
- key_parameters: <updateCache=logical indicating whether to download the latest KEGG pathways ;; edgeTypeAttr=the edge attribute containing interaction types (e.g., "subtype") ;; edgeWeightByType=a list mapping interaction types to numeric weights ;; weights=a vector of node weights, typically computed using alphaMLG or alpha1MR ;; nboot=number of bootstrap simulations for p-value computation ;; pathNames=a named vector of pathway titles ;; order.by=column name to sort the summary table by>
- alternatives: <The documentation mentions Onto-Express for GO profiling and SPIA (Signaling Pathway Impact Analysis) as related methods, but ROntoTools should be preferred when running the updated Pathway-Express or Primary dis-regulation algorithms.>
- when_to_use: <Use when analyzing high-throughput gene expression data (fold changes and p-values) to identify significantly impacted signaling pathways while accounting for pathway topology, gene-gene interaction types, and the position/magnitude of expression changes.>
- pitfalls: <Downloading and updating the KEGG cache with updateCache=TRUE is time-consuming and depends on network bandwidth. Low values for nboot can lead to less accurate p-value estimations.>

workflows.name: pathway_express
workflows.intent: Perform Pathway-Express analysis to identify significantly impacted signaling pathways using gene fold changes, p-values, and pathway topology.
input: topTable.RData (a data frame containing logFC, P.Value, adj.P.Val, and entrez gene IDs)
workflows.stages: 1. Download and load KEGG pathway graphs using keggPathwayGraphs ;; 2. Set edge weights based on interaction subtypes using setEdgeWeights ;; 3. Retrieve pathway names using keggPathwayNames ;; 4. Filter differentially expressed genes and extract fold changes and p-values ;; 5. Set node weights using gene significance via setNodeWeights and alphaMLG ;; 6. Run Pathway-Express analysis using pe ;; 7. Summarize results using Summary ;; 8. Visualize results using plot and renderGraph
workflows.code:
kpg <- keggPathwayGraphs("hsa", verbose = FALSE)
kpg <- setEdgeWeights(kpg, edgeTypeAttr = "subtype", 
	edgeWeightByType = list(activation = 1, inhibition = -1, 
		expression = 1, repression = -1), 
	defaultWeight = 0)
kpn <- keggPathwayNames("hsa")
load(system.file("extdata/E-GEOD-21942.topTable.RData", package = "ROntoTools"))
fc <- top$logFC[top$adj.P.Val <= .01]
names(fc) <- top$entrez[top$adj.P.Val <= .01]
pv <- top$P.Value[top$adj.P.Val <= .01]
names(pv) <- top$entrez[top$adj.P.Val <= .01]
ref <- top$entrez
kpg <- setNodeWeights(kpg, weights = alphaMLG(pv), defaultWeight = 1)
peRes <- pe(x = fc, graphs = kpg, ref = ref,  nboot = 200, verbose = FALSE)
head(Summary(peRes))
head(Summary(peRes, pathNames = kpn, totalAcc = FALSE, totalPert = FALSE,
             pAcc = FALSE, pORA = FALSE, comb.pv = NULL, order.by = "pPert"))
plot(peRes)
plot(peRes, c("pAcc", "pORA"), comb.pv.func = compute.normalInv, threshold = .01)
plot(peRes@pathways[["path:hsa05216"]], type = "two.way")
plot(peRes@pathways[["path:hsa05216"]], type = "boot")
p <- peRes@pathways[["path:hsa05216"]]
g <- layoutGraph(p@map, layoutType = "dot")
graphRenderInfo(g) <- list(fixedsize = FALSE)
edgeRenderInfo(g) <- peEdgeRenderInfo(p)
nodeRenderInfo(g) <- peNodeRenderInfo(p)
renderGraph(g)

workflows.name: primary_dis_regulation
workflows.intent: Perform Primary dis-regulation analysis to analyze signaling pathways based on the unexplained dis-regulation of genes and upstream signaling.
input: topTable.RData (a data frame containing logFC, P.Value, adj.P.Val, and entrez gene IDs)
workflows.stages: 1. Download and load KEGG pathway graphs using keggPathwayGraphs ;; 2. Retrieve pathway names using keggPathwayNames ;; 3. Filter differentially expressed genes and extract fold changes and p-values ;; 4. Run Primary dis-regulation analysis using pDis ;; 5. Summarize results using Summary
workflows.code:
kpg <- keggPathwayGraphs("hsa", verbose = FALSE)
kpn <- keggPathwayNames("hsa")
load(system.file("extdata/E-GEOD-21942.topTable.RData", package = "ROntoTools"))
fc <- top$logFC[top$adj.P.Val <= .01]
names(fc) <- top$entrez[top$adj.P.Val <= .01]
pv <- top$P.Value[top$adj.P.Val <= .01]
names(pv) <- top$entrez[top$adj.P.Val <= .01]
ref <- top$entrez
pDisRes <- pDis(x = fc, graphs = kpg, ref = ref,  nboot = 200, verbose = FALSE)
head(Summary(pDisRes))
head(Summary(pDisRes, pathNames = kpn, totalpDis = FALSE,
              pORA = FALSE, comb.pv = NULL, order.by = "ppDis"))
